meta.regulator: NCISM (National Commission for Indian System of Medicine), Board of Ayurveda
meta.curriculum: BAMS (Ayurvedacharya) competency-based dynamic curriculum (CBDC) under the NCISM Minimum Standards of Undergraduate Ayurveda Education Regulations, 2022; applicable from the 2021-22 batch

programme_structure.professionals: Three professionals of 18 months each, followed by 12 months compulsory rotatory internship (total 5.5 years)
programme_structure.terms: Each professional has three terms of six months; term 1 and 2 end with term tests, term 3 with the university examination
programme_structure.electives: Minimum three electives per professional (nine in total, 45 hours each) must be completed before the final examination; electives carry 10 marks in some subjects (Sets FA-FC, SA-SC, TA-TC)
programme_structure.medium_of_instruction: Sanskrit, Hindi, any recognised regional language or English; English when an institute admits students from several states

exam_pattern.theory_paper: Each 100-mark theory paper (3 hours): Q1 20 MCQ x 1 = 20, Q2 8 SAQ x 5 = 40, Q3 4 LAQ x 10 = 40. MCQs are therefore 20% of every theory paper.
exam_pattern.pass_criteria: Minimum 50% in theory and 50% in the practical component (practical/clinical + viva + IA + elective), separately in each subject
exam_pattern.internal_assessment: IA (15 or 30 marks) is the average of three term assessments; each term assessment combines periodical assessments and a term test
exam_pattern.verification_note: Paper layout verified from official NCISM syllabus PDFs; pass criteria taken from a secondary summary of the MSE 2022 regulation (verify against the gazette).

later_revisions.item: Ayurpraveshika revised transitional curriculum for First Professional BAMS, issued by Board of Ayurveda, NCISM on 03.10.2025, for students admitted in 2025-26 onwards
later_revisions.impact: Foundation/induction programme at the start of 1st professional; subject list and codes unchanged as far as found

later_revisions.item: National Exit Test (NExT) is applicable to AYUSH students admitted from academic year 2021-22 onwards
later_revisions.impact: Future exit/licensing exam for this cohort; format not yet published on the NCISM page as of fetch

later_revisions.item: Second and third professional syllabus PDFs carry 'Applicable from 2021-22 batch, from the academic year 2023-24 onwards for 5 years or until further notification'
later_revisions.impact: Current syllabus documents remain the 2021-22 CBDC set; no replacement subject structure found

meta.verification_legend: verified:true = taken from an official NCISM document or a verbatim copy of it (college-hosted PDF, Scribd/SlideShare copy of the NCISM PDF). verified:false = reconstructed or not extractable; check before relying on it.
meta.id_policy: Subject ids are the project's working ids (stable). 'code' holds the official NCISM code. Topic ids are stable kebab-case.
meta.topic_aliases_note: Legacy topic_id values already used in content/data/quiz/*.json, mapped to the closest canonical topic (approximate, many-to-one). Resolve a quiz topic_id by looking it up here first. Quiz items tagged sa1-ah-su-16 ... sa1-ah-su-30 are OUTSIDE the SA1 syllabus (SA1 covers Ashtanga Hridaya Sutrasthana 1-15 only); they are mapped to the Panchakarma, Shalakya or Shalya topic that teaches that chapter's content. Several mappings cross subjects (e.g. pk-raktamoksana -> st-raktamokshana). Retag quiz items to canonical ids when convenient.
